name: impeller
description: Open impeller disc D80. Hub D20 (rising to Z22) with a D8 bore. The disc surface between hub and rim is a concave conical dish falling from Z12 at the hub to Z6 at R36, then flat to the rim. Six backward-curved blades 2.5 mm thick (circular-arc camber) stand on the dish with tops at Z18, R0.8 not required (sharp). (A rim chamfer was intended but is not in the CAD.)
